   COLOMBIAN PORTS.
2. THE ARRIVAL OF YACHTS, SAILBOATS AND PLEASURE
   CRAFT, WHATEVER THEIR COUNTRY OF ORIGIN, IS
   SUSPENDED. EXCEPTION 1. THOSE WHOSE CREW IS
   COLOMBIAN OR FOREIGNERS WITH RESIDENCE IN
   COLOMBIA, WHO MUST ENTER A PERIOD OF ISOLATION
   IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE HEALTH MEASURES THAT
   HAVE BEEN ESTABLISHED BY THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT.

   CONDITIONS, BREAKDOWNS, ETC.) BUT LANDING SHALL
   NOT BE PERMITTED UNTIL THE RELEVANT HEALTH
   PROTOCOLS HAVE BEEN COMPLIED WITH.

   ARE RESTRICTED DURING THE TIME SPENT IN PORT,
   EXCEPT IN CASES OF MEDICAL EMERGENCY, AS
   CONSIDERED BY THE SANITARY AUTHORITY.

   TO ARRIVAL IN A COLOMBIAN PORT, THEY MUST REPORT
   ON THE HEALTH STATUS OF EACH CREW MEMBER ON
   BOARD AND THEIR TRAVEL ITINERARY FOR THE LAST
   14 DAYS.

   CHANNEL 16 TRAFFIC CONTROL STATION.
